export interface Product {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  price: number;
  category: string;
  inventory: number;
}
 
export interface CartItem extends Product {
  quantity: number;
}
 
export interface CartState {
  items: CartItem[];
  isOpen: boolean;
  user: { name: string; email: string } | null;
}
